lead: Valencia’s elegant Eixample: grand avenues with modernista buildings, the Turia Gardens at your door and the city’s best dining area one step away.

The accommodation on the Gran Vía reflects the diversity of the neighbourhood: a boutique B&B in a century-old building with Valencian ceramic mosaics and an interior garden, and a 4-star hotel with 50 years of history on the Gran Vía Marqués del Turia itself, with direct views of the tree-lined avenue.

Staying here means having the Turia Gardens at street level — ideal for going for a run, cycling to the sea or simply strolling 9 km of urban park —, the Mercado de Colón 8 minutes away and the Palau de la Música as a neighbour.

items.kicker: Boutique B&B · Calle del Taquígrafo Martí, 10
items.title: ABCyou Bed & Breakfast
items.subtitle: 1920 Valencian building · Ceramic mosaics · Interior garden · 12 rooms · Bicycles for rent
items.body: The ABCyou Bed & Breakfast is one of the most authentic and best-loved accommodations in the neighbourhood. It occupies a lovely 1920 Valencian building on Calle del Taquígrafo Martí, a few steps from the Gran Vía, and combines traditional Valencian ceramic mosaics with small touches of contemporary design. Its 12 rooms are all different: those facing the street have a balcony with views of the neighbourhood, those facing the interior have their own sitting room, and some have a bathtub. All have a private bathroom, air conditioning, free WiFi and a small fridge. A continental breakfast (orange juice, coffee or tea, toast or croissant) is included when booking directly. The interior garden — an oasis of peace in the heart of the city — is one of the most prized spaces of the property. You can rent a bicycle or electric scooter at reception. A 5-minute walk from the Plaza de Toros and the Estación del Nord.

items.kicker: 4-star hotel · Gran Vía Marqués del Turia, 80
items.title: Hotel Dimar
items.subtitle: 50 years in the neighbourhood · Beside the Turia Gardens · 96 rooms · Junior Suites with terrace onto the Gran Vía · Spa and gym
items.body: The Hotel Dimar is a symbol of the Gran Vía neighbourhood: opened in 1975 by the Martínez-Dicenta family, it was one of the first hotels in Valencia and has been the hotel heart of the Eixample for 50 years. Located at number 80 of the Gran Vía Marqués del Turia, a few steps from the Plaza de Cánovas, the Turia Gardens and the Palau de la Música, it offers a privileged location on the city’s best axis of leisure and shopping. Its 96 modern-design rooms have wooden floors, minibar, coffee machine, free WiFi, individually controlled air conditioning and a full private bathroom. The 7 Junior Suites include a separate sitting area, dressing room and private terrace with views of the Gran Vía. The restaurant Salon Turia serves a buffet breakfast with local products (7:00–10:30), and the hotel has a bar, a spa with massage area, a gym and room service until 23:00. The Colón metro station is 600 metres away.

blocks.title: Tips for staying on the Gran Vía
items: The Hotel Dimar has been in the neighbourhood for 50 years — ask for a room or suite with a terrace onto the Gran Vía for one of the most elegant views in Valencia
The ABCyou B&B includes a continental breakfast when you book directly on its website — freshly squeezed Valencian orange juice included
From the Hotel Dimar, the Turia Gardens are literally around the corner: rent a bicycle and pedal to the City of Arts in 15 minutes
The Mercado de Colón (8 min walk from ABCyou) is the best place in the neighbourhood for a drink in the afternoon: tapas, cocktails and a select atmosphere in a modernista market
The Cánovas area — between the Dimar and Ruzafa — concentrates some of the best restaurants in the city: book a table for dinner, especially at weekends
The Colón metro (600 m from the Dimar) connects directly with the airport, the beach and the historic centre: the most convenient transport in Valencia
